Container.Name: werejugo
Container.Overview: Werejugo web app (nginx). Serves the UI and proxies /api + /uploads to the backend. This is the only container you expose. Open the WebUI to use the app. Start it last. Must share the custom "werejugo" network.
Container.Description: Werejugo web app. The single container you expose; proxies the API internally.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port to open the app on.

Config.Name: BACKEND_HOST
Config.Description: Name of the backend container on the shared network.
